title: Product Title and Selling Points Generator
description: A web application that generates e-commerce product titles and selling points based on user-uploaded images and descriptions.

features.name: Image Upload
features.description: Allows users to upload a product image for analysis.

features.name: Text Input for Needs
features.description: Enables users to input a sentence describing their specific needs for the product.

features.name: AI-Generated Product Title
features.description: Generates a suitable e-commerce product title based on the uploaded image and user input.

features.name: AI-Generated Selling Points
features.description: Creates three selling points tailored to the target audience specified in the user input.

features.name: Target Audience Customization
features.description: Allows the application to adapt the output to specific demographics, such as young people.

constraints: Requires integration with an AI model for text and image analysis
target_users: E-commerce sellers and marketers looking to generate product descriptions and selling points
data_requirements: Storage for uploaded images and user input, along with temporary storage for AI-generated outputs
